subject: Geopolitics
title: Russia's Media Control
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Russia's Media Control.

hook.text: Russian state TV reaches 90% of households. Independent outlets were shut down. One narrative dominates the airwaves.

buildup.text: Putin gradually seized control of media after 2000.

discovery.text: State TV mixes entertainment with political messaging. Audiences absorb propaganda alongside game shows and talk shows.

twist.text: After the Ukraine invasion, Russia blocked the last independent outlets and criminalized calling it a 'war.

climax.text: Russia shows that media control is gradual. By the time citizens notice, all alternatives are already gone.

punchline.text: Control the screen and you control the story.

quiz.question: How did Russia achieve media control?
options: Through a single sudden takeover of all outlets
Gradually buying or closing independent outlets over two decades
By offering better salaries to all journalists
